acceptPreOrder.acceptOrdersWithoutStockDescription: Allow accepting orders even when stock is not available. Useful for pre-orders or backorders.
acceptPreOrder.enableAcceptOrdersWithoutStockDescriptio: When enabled, the system will accept sales orders even if stock is not available (pre-orders).
acceptPreOrder.disableAcceptOrdersWithoutStockDescripti: When disabled, orders will be blocked when stock is not available.
acceptPreOrder.toggleWillRequireConfirmation: Toggling this setting will require confirmation.
acceptPreOrder.updateFailed: Failed to update settings. Please try again.

unsubscribedDeals.title: Show default store deals in CLUB APP
unsubscribedDeals.description: When enabled, items from your linked primary business ({{primary}}){{secondaryText}} catalogs will be shown on the CLUB APP even if they are not in your subscribed list.
unsubscribedDeals.enableDescription: Enabling this will allow you to see and sell items from your primary business ({{primary}}){{secondaryText}} catalogs even if they are not in your subscribed list.
unsubscribedDeals.disableDescription: Disabling this will restrict you to only seeing and selling your subscribed items.
unsubscribedDeals.notShowing: Currently not showing default store deals.

onlinePriceOnApp.title: Show online price in CLUB APP
onlinePriceOnApp.description: When enabled, the online market price (Amazon/Flipkart) is shown alongside your selling price on the CLUB APP. Disable it to hide the online price from customers.
onlinePriceOnApp.enableDescription: Enabling this will show the online market price (Amazon/Flipkart) next to your selling price on the CLUB APP.
onlinePriceOnApp.disableDescription: Disabling this will hide the online market price from customers on the CLUB APP. Your selling price will still be shown.
onlinePriceOnApp.compactVisible: Customers see these online prices next to your selling price.
onlinePriceOnApp.compactHidden: Customers don't see these online prices — only your selling price.

onlinePriceVisibility.title: Online price visibility
onlinePriceVisibility.description: Choose how customers see pricing for electronics products on the CLUB APP.
onlinePriceVisibility.contactViaWhatsApp: Show WhatsApp contact for electronics purchase
onlinePriceVisibility.contactViaWhatsAppHint: Hides the price and Add to Cart. Customers tap Contact to ask for the price on WhatsApp.
onlinePriceVisibility.showOnlinePrice: Show online price on app for comparison
onlinePriceVisibility.showOnlinePriceHint: Display Amazon/Flipkart prices next to your selling price.
onlinePriceVisibility.onlinePriceHiddenByWhatsApp: Prices and Add to Cart are hidden. Customers must tap Contact to ask for the price.
onlinePriceVisibility.compactVisible: Customers see these online prices next to your selling price.
onlinePriceVisibility.compactHidden: Customers don't see these online prices — only your selling price.
onlinePriceVisibility.compactContactMode: Prices and Add to Cart are hidden; customers tap Contact to ask for the price.
onlinePriceVisibility.enableContactDescription: Prices and the Add to Cart button will be hidden for electronics products on the CLUB APP. Customers must tap the Contact button to ask you for the price on WhatsApp.
onlinePriceVisibility.disableContactDescription: Prices and the Add to Cart button will be shown again for electronics products, and you can choose whether to display online prices.
onlinePriceVisibility.enableOnlinePriceDescription: Enabling this will show the online market price (Amazon/Flipkart) next to your selling price on the CLUB APP.
onlinePriceVisibility.disableOnlinePriceDescription: Disabling this will hide the online market price from customers on the CLUB APP. Your selling price will still be shown.
onlinePriceVisibility.updateFailed: Failed to update settings. Please try again.
